description: Two September 2005 codes specify requirements for small combustion facilities. The energy-recovery code covers used-oil combustion units or space heaters, alternative-fuel quality parameters and waste-as-fuel emission limits. The small-incinerator code covers mobile or small facilities treating less than ten tonnes of non-hazardous waste per month, including sampling and primary/secondary chamber design and installation requirements. Both require registration. They are grouped as companion design/regulatory information sources, with distinct scopes.
